notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

For those of you who participated in the Kickstarter campaign for The Anomaly, thank you so much!  We received such a large amount of support from everyone involved and we couldn't be happier with the general feedback we've received and lessons learned.

Moving forward, we'll continue to post weekly updates regarding development on our Twitter feed: @annexeint.  Be sure to follow us to keep up-to-date with all future updates and news regarding the full release of The Anomaly!

Also, feel free to contact us on any of our social media platforms or on our website with any questions, comments, concerns, joys, praises, etc!  We'd absolutely love to hear from you and broaden our relationships with all of our fans and friends.  After all, [i]you[/i] make it possible for us to keep doing what we love--producing games and software for everyone's enjoyment!

Thanks again for all the love and support!

Cheers,
Brett Martin
AI
